title: First Unique Character Index
statement: Given a string s consisting of lowercase English letters, return the index of the first character that does not repeat anywhere else in the string. If every character repeats, return -1.
hints: Counting how many times each character occurs is a job for a hash map, and it lets you avoid rescanning the string for every character.
First build a frequency map of every character in one pass, then scan the string again looking for the first character whose count is exactly 1.
counts = {}; for ch in s: counts[ch] = counts.get(ch, 0) + 1. Then for i, ch in enumerate(s): if counts[ch] == 1: return i. Return -1 if the loop finishes.
